articles.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
articles.summary: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.summary: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
articles.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.
